scope: First audio playback through mainline QDSP6, SLIMbus and the new WCD9306 codec component (audio probe kernel, RAM boot; installed system unchanged)
stack: fx0-linux integration/fx0-audio: QDSP6 services + ASM front-end DAIs (MSM8226 DTSI), NGD start without DSP restart, wcd9306 component (SLIMbus AIF1 playback, RX1 -> RX3 interpolator -> class-D speaker, MCLK/bandgap/clock-buffer supply, vendor register defaults), apq8096-style card 'LG Fx0' (MultiMedia1 -> SLIMBUS_0_RX -> codec), speaker boost GPIO60, codec MCLK = RPM div_clk1 on PM8226 GPIO1
debugging: q6asm-dai needs per-DAI child nodes (added MultiMedia1-3)

AFE port start (0x100e5, port 0x4000) failed with ADSP error 1 because the codec reported five RX channels; q6afe-dai copies that count into the SLIMbus port config. Reporting only AIF1's two channels fixed it
defining the SLIMbus channels before the AFE start (experiment) made no difference; the final driver keeps wcd9335's trigger ordering
